academics.initialSelection: Explicit major selection once per saved chat; all three belonging subjects start at zero, with no default choice
academics.progress: Each subject owns independent exact half-point progress, targets and stage; other-major subjects appear after committed reading

channels.library: Major or cross-major subjects at the study desk or explicit reading anchor
channels.bookshop: Explicit reading at the existing bookshop location in both 3D and novel modes; no added interior

academics.settlement: Eligibility, worst-case energy, clock and points limits checked before sampling; time and cross-major outcome drawn only on explicit confirmation, then resources, subject points, receipt and journal saved atomically
academics.netEffects: Outcome modifiers are added to normal study costs before clamping; lastGain stores actual net morale/stress and energy consumed
academics.migration: Strict 1.9 migration retains every old point on the old selected subject and adds the other two major subjects at zero; historical lastGain survives with unknown channel/outcome/effects null. Earlier supported saves keep all existing data and academics null. No retrospective awards.
academics.existingData: Existing decimal energy, needs, inventory, lastStudy, phone, story, contacts, journal, transit, scene and original one-off schedule are preserved
academics.timetable: Fixed derived weekly six-slot timetable for the selected major; opening it does not mark attendance, mutate the original schedule or award points
academics.receipt: Saved channel and interaction identity distinguish classroom/library results from bookshop reading; refresh consumes saved results without resampling
academics.nonLearningActions: Free observation, ten-minute shelf browsing, selecting subjects, opening the timetable, completing old schedule items and dialogue award no study points
academics.travel: Zero-energy novel travel remains permitted and charges at most the available energy; study resource requirements remain separate
academics.modelContext: All saved subject progress, stage goals, timetable and lastGain are supplied as authoritative data; no model-assigned progress

targetedRetry.sameSourceConfirmation: Parent reported the targeted retry used the same production and test source

initialFailure.test: scene-only free movement can actually walk from the original south-gate spawn along connected paths to every campus and street landmark
initialFailure.kind: 15000ms resource/time limit; no assertion failure reported

unit.aggregation: 346 unique initial test identities; the single timed-out traversal is covered by the 12/12 same-source targeted rerun. This does not claim an entirely green first run.
